t: This was the De Morgan Centre, a gallery in the London Borough of Wandsworth. It studied nineteenth-century art and society, and for a few years it was home to the De Morgan Collection. The collection was founded by A. M. W. Stirling, a British writer and art collector. Much of her writing dealt with the lives and reminiscences of the landed gentry of Yorkshire. She also wrote under the alias Percival Pickering.
